speaker: Doctor
text: That's helpful. To narrow this down, can you tell me if you've experienced similar knee swelling in other family members, and if so, at what age did they start having symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant clue given the age of onset; have you noticed if the swelling moves around the leg or if the knee appears misaligned when walking? Also, does the child have any history of joint dislocations or other connective tissue issues?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Swelling of the right knee. I also have No recent trauma or injury, Familial history of similar symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease (or potentially Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, but Perthes fits the age and unilateral swelling without trauma best). REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray Right Knee and Hip.
